content.short: Arc8 by Gamee is a mobile gaming platform with original games and customizable tools for Web3 projects.
content.description: Arc8 is a mobile gaming platform launched in 2021, available on the iOS App Store and Google Play. It introduces Web3 concepts such as tokens and NFTs in a gamified way, rewarding players for skill and time spent. Regular airdrops and quests incentivize discovery of other Web3 games and projects. The platform also offers a configurable toolkit of events and features for Web3 projects, brands, and communities to gain exposure and monetize their existing audiences. Alongside original games from the GAMEE team, Arc8 features content from third-party creators, with a select few titles exclusive to NFT owners.
